text.tspan: What He is: He’s my Savior
Praise of the Lord — His Salvation
What He is: He’s a God-man,
Living God as man, He paved the way
For God to live in me today.
He’s to God’s right hand exalted.
God was incarnated for His plan;
He lived, He died, He rose as man,
What He is: He’s our High Priest.
Like us tempted, yet He’s without sin;
We boldly come to God through Him.
What He is: He’s within us.
He is living now within us.
As the Spirit He is saving me.
When He comes, salvation comes to us.
